event.text: A chest in the middle of the road, unlocked. Too easy?

options.text: Two times in three, a legendary piece. Otherwise it bites: a hard fight.

event.name: The Master Smith
event.text: A smith with a portable forge and a price for everything. "Bring me anything. I'll make it better."

options.label: TEMPER
options.text: A common or uncommon piece of yours becomes one of the next rarity, of its kind.

options.label: REFORGE
options.text: A rare piece of yours is reforged into a legendary of its kind.

notes: The Master Smith: sell him scrap.
